subject: MedTech segmentation evaluation — post-call notes and questionnaire

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: MedTech segmentation evaluation — post-call notes and questionnaire

Hi Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our conversation and the concrete next items we discussed so your security and infra teams can triage: 

- SOC 2 / compliance: you mentioned a SOC 2 Type II report is in progress with an estimated completion Q1 2027. Please confirm scope (production vs. staging).
- Data residency & regulation: you flagged HIPAA-sensitive workflows for two product lines and GDPR concerns for EU customers.
- Deployment modes: we reviewed three approaches we support: a) VPC-isolated hosted instance with private peering, b) Dedicated private footprint (single-tenant within our cloud region), and c) fully on-prem / air-gapped package. I captured rough tradeoffs in the attached intake PDF.
- Network artifacts requested: network diagram (current topology), CIDR ranges for peering or transit, and expected egress patterns (avg/peak tokens/sec).
- Questionnaire: I attached our short intake (medtech-security-intake.pdf) — if your security team can complete the highlighted sections (SOC 2 scope, encryption/KMS requirements, allowed ingress).

Proposed next steps:
1) Your security lead shares the completed intake + any existing SOC 2 scopes by EOD Wednesday (11/11).
2) Technical follow-up: 30-minute call between your infra/security and our solutions engineers week of 11/15 to run a quick topology sketch and CI/CD/maintenance windows.
3) We’ll prepare three deployment sketches (VPC peering, dedicated private, air-gap) and a preliminary runbook and share before the follow-up call.

Attachments: medtech-security-intake.pdf (short questionnaire).

Let me know if the timeline or asks need to shift.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Kimberly —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers and context from our side: 

- SOC 2: We have a Type I in place for the SaaS platform; Type II is scheduled and scoped to production systems (targeting end of Q1 2027). I’ll attach the high-level SOC plan.
- HIPAA: Two of our product streams are covered (PHI flows). Those teams will want encryption-at-rest + per-customer KMS separation options.
- Air-gap feasibility: we are interested in an air-gapped deploy if the runbook for maintenance windows is reasonable — need clarity on patching process and offline telemetry options.

I’ve looped in Laura (Security Ops) and pasted security@ so they can pick up the intake. I attached our security team contact as a vCard.

We’ll try to get the intake back to you by EOD Wednesday. For the technical call, 11/16 or 11/17 in the morning Pacific would work for us.

Thanks,
Rajiv

MedTech Inc.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedTech segmentation evaluation — post-call notes and questionnaire

Hi Rajiv / Laura —

Thanks for the quick reply and the timeline. A few technical clarifications we need so the architecture sketches are useful: 

- Scope question: when you say "PHI flows" — can you enumerate which endpoints/processes will touch PHI (ingest APIs, long-term storage, logging/analytics)? That drives whether we recommend encryption, tokenization, or full on-prem isolation.
- Throughput: please confirm expected average request rate and a 95th percentile peak (tokens/sec or requests/min) so we can size KV cache and batching profiles.
- Network: if you have existing transit or transit-EVPN/CSP peering constraints please provide CIDR blocks and whether you require static NAT or full BGP peering.
- Maintenance & updates: for air-gapped option we need to know acceptable maintenance windows and who will be responsible for applying signed patches (you vs. our on-site runbook team).

We typically propose three concrete patterns: 1) VPC-isolated hosted with Private Interconnect — minimal infra changes, fastest to production; 2) Dedicated private footprint — single-tenant within our region, KMS integration per-customer; 3) Air-gapped on-prem appliance — full isolation, manual patch windows, restricted telemetry. Each has different SLAs and cost profile.

Could you attach your network diagram and a short list of systems that process PHI before EOD Wednesday (11/11)? I attached a short doc with the specific fields we need (arch-questions.docx). Also happy to cover items on the call next week — I can host the technical call if Kimberly’s schedule is tight.

Best,
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: security-team-contact.vcf (vCard), initial SOC plan (linked by separate email).

Regards,
Rajiv
